title: Patch: the card crafter shows its preset suggestions again

**Issue #4294 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4294: Patch: the card crafter shows its preset suggestions again
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What happens

When a card has you build a custom card in the craft editor, the editor no longer shows the prefab suggestions (the seeded presets) that used to let you start from a ready-made card.

The cards that open the editor (`choose_craft`):

- Meditative #17 **True Craft a Card** (`crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs`): no mode
- Meditative+ #16 **Jazakus** (`c016_jazakus.rs`): `potion` mode
- Meditative+ #16.1 **Jazakus Prime** (`c016_1_jazakus_prime.rs`): `hugePotion` mode
- Meditative+ #26 **Scratch Pad** (`c026_scratch_pad.rs`): `scratch` mode. This one is **meant** to show no suggestions (R1182002), so leave it as it is.

(Core #99 Craft a Card is Discover + Fuse and never opens the editor, so this issue doesn't cover it.)

### What should happen

R880 and R881 (`spec/rulings/R0880.md`, `R0881.md`): a `craft` prompt offers four seeded presets (Unit, Spell, Field Spell, Trap, or up to `CRAFT_PRESETS` Potions in the potion modes, R1182000/R1182001/R1563008). These are built from the prompt's offer (R1563007), and every mode except `scratch` shows them in the editor as suggestions the player can click to load that recipe.

### What I found (cause not confirmed)

Reading the code, every part still looks connected, so the builder needs to reproduce this in the client before changing anything:

- Engine: `effects/choose.rs` `choose_craft` puts `subsystems::craft::presets_for` into the prompt's options, and `view_for.rs` `option_view` copies `Selection::Craft { recipe }` into `PendingOption.recipe`.
- Client: `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx` around lines 134 and 329 renders the `.craft-suggestions` row (`data-testid="craft-preset-N"`) when `!scratch && presets.length > 0`. Its styles are in `craft.css` around line 240.
- Last change to the editor: #4119's audit (87bd2795), which only swapped `sheetQuery` to `queryList`. #3043 (True Craft's points cut to 80%, R3043000) threaded the mode through `craft_presets`.

Things to check: whether the presets come back empty or invalid for some cost or offer (`preset_unit` and `preset_effect` can drop a preset the budget can't afford, and `craft_presets` uses `out.extend`), whether the options carry `recipe` across the WASM/wire boundary, and whether the row renders but sits off-screen or hidden, especially in the phone `sheet` layout.

### How to reproduce

`/dev/hotseat` or `/practice`: cast True Craft a Card, pick a cost, and look for the Suggestions row in the editor. Repeat with Jazakus's and Jazakus Prime's battlecries.

### Acceptance

- In the live client, the editor shows the presets as clickable suggestions for True Craft a Card (every cost 0 to `CRAFT_MAX_COST`, both faces), Jazakus and Jazakus Prime, and clicking one loads its recipe.
- Scratch Pad still shows none (R1182002).
- A test pins down the root cause where it was (engine, wire or web), named after the ruling it proves (R881 or R1563007). If the fix needs a decision the spec doesn't make, it gets a new ruling under this issue's block.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44673711531)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Restore the craft editor's preset suggestion buttons so they show and load on click for Meditative #17 True Craft a Card at every cost 0 to `CRAFT_MAX_COST` on both faces, for Jazakus (`potion` mode) and Jazakus Prime (`hugePotion` mode), while Scratch Pad (`scratch` mode) keeps showing none per R1182002. Pin the root cause with a test named after the ruling it proves (R881 or R1563007 in the engine, R880 in the web), since the defect could sit in preset generation, the WASM/wire transport, or the client's render gate.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs` | change, only in outcome A | One of `preset_unit` (1091), `preset_effect` (1124), `craft_presets` (1172), `craft_potion_presets` (1219), `presets_for` (1317), `roll_offer` (1282): the helper the probe proves guilty |
| `crates/engine/src/effects/choose.rs` | change, only in outcome A/B | `choose_craft` (535): options or mode plumbing, only if the probe proves it guilty |
| `crates/engine/src/view_for.rs` | change, only in outcome B | `option_view` Craft arm (1718) or `prompt_view` (1814): recipe transport, only if guilty |
| `crates/engine/src/wire/view.rs` | change, only in outcome B | `PendingOption.recipe` serde attrs (1515): only if guilty |
| `crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs` | change, only in outcome B | `view_for` (343) / `craft_preview` (621): JSON boundary, only if guilty |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts` | change, only in outcome B | `viewFor` (237) / `craftPreview` (617): only if guilty |
| `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx` | change, only in outcome C | Presets gate (134) or suggestions row (329): only if guilty |
| `apps/web/src/game/craft/craft.css` | change, only in outcome C | `.craft-suggestions` (240) or sheet rules (344): only if guilty |
| `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx` | change, only in outcome C | Craft branch (1964): only if it drops options; otherwise read-only |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/craft.rs` | change | Engine pinning test (also the step-2 probe) |
| `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx` | change | Web pinning test (outcomes B/C) |
| `spec/rulings/R4294000.md` | new, only if a new undecided decision appears | Ruling note, lowest free in this issue's block |
| `spec/pending/4294.md` | new, only if a new ruling appears | The §11 paragraph |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (daily fold owns them; never run `cargo jackioh spec index`); `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative_plus/c026_scratch_pad.rs` behavior; Core #99; budgets or constants except under CLAUDE.md rule 9. Governing: SPEC §§6.3, 8.8, 8.9, 10.6, 10.8 and R880, R881, R882, R883, R1182000, R1182001, R1182002, R1563007, R1563008, R3043000, R79, R97.

## Steps

1. Baseline first. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' craft`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c017_true_craft_a_card`, and `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`. Record greens; do not change code yet.
2. Write the engine pinning test first (it doubles as the probe). In `crates/engine/tests/rules/craft.rs`, copy the `crafted_at` scenario pattern from `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs` (its `scenario`, `s.play`, `s.answer` helpers): for each cost 0 to `CRAFT_MAX_COST`, open True Craft's craft prompt and assert the pending options equal `presets_for` output, count 1 to `CRAFT_PRESETS`, every option carrying a recipe that `validate_answer` accepts; repeat for `potion` and `hugePotion` modes (framed recipes, 1 to `CRAFT_PRESETS`) via the Jazakus scripts. Name it `fn r881_presets_answer_every_craft_prompt`. Run it with `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r881_presets`. If it fails, outcome A: fix the guilty helper in `crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs`, keeping Unit-first order, `out.truncate(CRAFT_PRESETS)`, mode-keyed budgets (R3043000), offer-drawn words/hats/verbs (R1563007), and Scratch Pad's engine-side presets for the AI/policy/timeout (R1182002). If it passes, keep the test and continue.
3. Probe the holder view in the same test file. After opening each prompt above, read `view_for` holder JSON: assert every option carries its `recipe` and the opponent's `Elsewhere` view carries none (R97). If the holder view lacks recipes, outcome B (engine view): fix `option_view`'s Craft arm, keeping holder-only redaction. If intact, continue.
4. Probe the client object. Read `apps/web/src/game/hotseat.test.ts` for the pattern that drives a hotseat game through the real WASM (`engine.viewFor(state, seat)` per `apps/web/src/game/hotseat.ts` 91-92). In a temporary scratch test (delete it after; only the final pinning test ships), open the True Craft prompt, print `pending.options` (length and which carry `recipe`), then render `CraftEditor` with that live pending object. If recipes are missing here but present in step 3, outcome B (WASM/web boundary): fix there and re-run the ts-features cargo test, committing any regenerated `apps/web/src/wire` diff. If the row renders with live props, outcome C: the defect is render/CSS — inspect `data-layout`, the `sheet` state from `queryList` (`apps/web/src/game/mediaQuery.ts`), and the sheet/panel rules in `craft.css`; fix the gate or rule, keeping `scratch ? []`, the 44px sheet targets, `PHONE_SHEET_QUERY` ownership in `apps/web/src/breakpoints.ts`, and the click-to-load `setRecipe` plus the `{type:"answer",choiceId,selection:[{pick:"craft",recipe}]}` send shape.
5. Finalize the pinning test at the guilty layer only: outcome A or engine-view B keeps the step-2/3 Rust test; WASM/web B or C adds `it("R880 shows the holder's preset recipes as clickable suggestions that load")` in `CraftEditor.test.tsx`, feeding the captured live pending (or the exact malformed shape found) and asserting each `craft-preset-N` button loads its recipe (points meter and face change) and Craft sends it. R880 is used because that file is already in R880's `proven_in`; do not cite R881 in a web file without adding it to `R0881.md`'s `proven_in`.
6. Run the acceptance sweep through tests, not by eye: True Craft costs 0-4 × base/Radiant, Jazakus, Jazakus Prime show 1-4 clickable suggestions that load; Scratch Pad shows none (existing `R1182002` tests in `CraftEditor.test.tsx` and `Prompt.test.tsx` still green, and engine scratch presets still exist for the AI per `craft_modes.rs`).
7. Add a ruling only if the fix needed a decision the spec does not make (R1563007 already settles one-to-four presets, so expect none). If one appears: follow Hearthstone semantics, write `spec/rulings/R4294000.md`, name the test `r4294000_…` / `it("R4294000 …")`, list files in `proven_in`, add the `**[[R4294000]] … (issue #4294, <date>)**: …` paragraph to `spec/pending/4294.md`, and run `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

- `crates/engine/tests/rules/craft.rs`, `fn r881_presets_answer_every_craft_prompt`: costs 0-4 plus potion/hugePotion modes yield 1-`CRAFT_PRESETS` answerable recipes; run `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r881_presets`. If guilty layer is the view, extend it with holder-carries-recipe / opponent-sees-none and run the same command.
- `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`, `it("R880 shows the holder's preset recipes as clickable suggestions that load")` (outcomes B/C only): live-shaped pending renders every `craft-preset-N`, click loads, Craft sends the recipe; run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`, plus `src/game/Prompt.test.tsx` and `src/game/actions.test.ts` if touched.
- Regression: existing `R1182002` scratch tests, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c016_jazakus` and `c016_1_jazakus_prime`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings` (and each touched crate), `cargo jackioh spec check` if any ruling was added or cited.

## Done when

- [ ] True Craft (costs 0-4, both faces), Jazakus, Jazakus Prime show clickable preset suggestions that load; Scratch Pad shows none
- [ ] Pinning test at the guilty layer fails without the fix and passes with it; no test elsewhere weakened
- [ ] Rustfmt, clippy on touched crates, touched web test files, and `spec check` (if ruling added/cited) pass
- [ ] No changes outside the Files table; every unsettled decision recorded in the report

## Risks

- Determinism/replay: presets come from the match rng; do not add randomness, reorder draws, or change recipe JSON shape (R882 digest stability — `frame` stays absent on unframed recipes).
- Hidden information: recipes travel to the holder only (R97/R880); do not leak them into `Elsewhere`, option counts, or logs.
- Purity: `crates/engine` clippy bans hold for tests too (no clock, I/O, threads, statics).
- AI/timeout path: engine presets must remain as prompt options even where the client hides them — never fix display by deleting options (`legalActions`, policy, R79 timeouts answer with one).
- Sheet layout shares queries with `prompt.css` via `PHONE_SHEET_QUERY`; do not hardcode a media query or shrink touch targets.

## Open questions

None. Reproduction settles the guilty layer; no person-only decision is anticipated. If step 7's ruling becomes necessary, it stays bot-doable under CLAUDE.md rule 3.
```
